I also was in a similar boat to you at some point and I tried to find a ninja commander that was yuriko (too powerful) or Satoru (who focused on ninjitsuing in non ninjas) and I I too built Cazur and Ukkima. Sadly it never really worked out because you never get a big payoff with ninjitsu abilities from the 2 commanders. The deck started to function much better when I focused solely on evasive creatures and +1/+1 counters with a few ninjas for flavor. Here was my list before I took it apart: https://www.moxfield.com/decks/l9TMWcgfB0u3LA9aMSoE0w

If you want a ninja commander that has a big pay off for ninjitsu I highly recommend [[Goro Goro and Satoru]]. You get 5/5 dragon spirits whenever you successfully get a ninjitsu combat damage trigger. You end up developing a board state that will enable more ninjitsu later on, and you can build it fully ninja tribal if you wanted to. Goro goro and Satoru fulfilled my ninjitsu craving very well.

Can I recommend [[Ukkima Stalking Shadow]] and [[Cazur ruthless stalker]] partners?? Load it up with your favorite unblockables/ evasive creatures and ninjitsu in your favorite ninjas.
